# Diametral Design System

> A flat, buildless design system: 1px rules, no shadows, no border-radius,
> white/whitesmoke surfaces, black ink, serif/Ufficio headings over Geist body,
> uppercase 0.08em labels, tabular numerals, one themeable accent. Every class is
> namespaced `.ds-*` and backed by `--ds-*` CSS custom properties.

Pick the layer first. In **React**, use `@diametral/design-system/react` — the
full typed component set, where the interactive components (sidebar collapse,
combobox, drawer, data table) ship their behaviour. **Anywhere else** — static
HTML, Vue, Angular, Django, Streamlit, email — include the stylesheet and use
`.ds-*` classes; no build step is required, and you wire the behaviour yourself.

```js
import "@diametral/design-system/css/diametral.css";
import { Sidebar, DataTable } from "@diametral/design-system/react";
```

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@diametral/design-system/dist/diametral.css">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

## Core reference
- [Design system for Claude](docs/for-claude.md): single-file, self-contained reference — principles, tokens, and the ~80 most-used classes with copy-paste HTML, plus where to find the rest. **Start here.**
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): npm / Vite / Next / Angular / Vue / Streamlit / CDN.
- [Components](docs/components.md): full component catalogue.
- [Foundations](docs/foundations.md): color, type, spacing, layout, borders, motion.
- [Recipes](docs/recipes.md): whole screens in React — app shell, CRUD list+detail, dashboard, auth gate.
- [Blocks & templates](https://littlebigcode.github.io/design-system/blocks): whole compositions — app chrome, auth, marketing, data+detail.
- [Agent index](docs/agent-index.json): every component, its category, its CSS file, and its examples richest-first — machine-readable.

## Rules (must follow)
- NO border-radius, NO box-shadow, NO gradients. Borders are 1px solid `var(--ds-rule)`.
- Use `.ds-*` classes; do not invent class names or restyle them with ad-hoc CSS.
- The accent `--ds-accent` is for emphasis only (links, key edges, the primary action is solid black `#161616`). It is themeable and has no fixed value — never hard-code it.
- Headings use the title font; labels are uppercase, letter-spaced, faint.
- Prefer semantic tokens (`--ds-ink`, `--ds-accent`, `--ds-rule`, …) over raw hex.
- A primitive is a fallback. Before assembling a screen from primitives, check whether a block or template already contains it — copying that and changing the content is the correct move.
